QuestInfo.name: [Orange Mushroom] Yearning to Jump
QuestInfo.0: Talk to the Scholarly 'Shroom about the secrets of Orange Mushrooms.
QuestInfo.2: You've decided to investigate the secrets of Orange Mushrooms. Talk to the Scholarly 'Shroom about your next task.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic#\r\nCan proceed to [Orange Mushroom] The Art of Seduction\r\n

0.0: Heya, human! Kind of weird for you to be studying Orange Mushrooms, huh? Still, we like the attention.

yes.0: First, I'll tell you a little bit about us. Listen up.
yes.1: Did you know that all Orange Mushrooms love to jump? I bet you didn't! Explains a lot about mushrooms bouncing around the forest, right?
yes.2: I once bounced along as they did. Never questioning, never wondering... why?
yes.3: The whole jumping business never sat well with me, you see. I'm a little too... refined for that. Yet I'd be reading a very smart-looking book, no pictures of course, and I'd suddenly jump and hit the roof. It would happen everywhere! At home, at work, on the toilet... Terrible thing.
yes.4: I looked into this strange instinct, and found that it's one of Maple World's 11 great monster mysteries! I devoted my research to the matter, and I've already got TWO hypotheses. Yeah, I know... pretty impressive.
yes.5: Let's look into the first hypothesis. Talk to me when you're ready.

no.0: Oh, come on! Let's explore! Research! Investigate!
